title: Residence Term of Creek Kids Club Extended Day Program Installment Arrangements
content:
**Term.** The residence term of a Creek Kids Club Extended Day Program installment arrangement looks at the student's district enrollment record in Student Enrollment, Transfers and Pre-Kindergarten Admissions for the 2026-27 school year:

| Student's district enrollment record for the 2026-27 school year | Installments taken away |
|---|---|
| the student holds no such record in status enrolled | 2 |
| the record in status enrolled is a Non-Resident Transfer | 1 |
| the record in status enrolled is any other enrollment type: Attendance Zone Enrollment, Intra-District Transfer (Space Available), Intra-District Transfer (Employee Child), Choice Program Enrollment, Pre-Kindergarten (State-Eligible) or Pre-Kindergarten (Tuition-Based) | none |

## Points of judgement

- The school year read is 2026-27, whatever school year the earlier-year Creek Kids Club enrollment covers.
- Only a record in status enrolled counts. A 2026-27 record that shows withdrawn, or a record for another school year, leaves the student with no such record, and 2 installments are taken away.
- The enrollment type is the one on the district record, not one the family describes.
